name: FLUX Best Practices
headline: FLUX Best Practices: Prompting Guide for Image
short_description: This skill ensures optimal prompt generation for BFL FLUX models, enhancing image quality and accuracy. It's designed for users creating prompts for text-to-image and image-to-image tasks.
author: black-forest-labs

sections.overview:
FLUX Best Practices is an official skill from Black Forest Labs that provides comprehensive prompting guidelines for all FLUX models, including FLUX.2 variants (klein, pro, flex, max, dev) and FLUX.1. The skill covers core principles, model-specific techniques, text-to-image and image-to-image prompting patterns, JSON structured prompting, hex color specification, typography rendering, and multi-reference image editing. It teaches FLUX-specific conventions such as avoiding negative prompts (which FLUX doesn't support), using quoted text for typography, specifying lighting for quality impact, and selecting the right model for your use case. Users benefit from detailed prompt structure templates and practical guidance on maximizing image quality and accuracy across different generation tasks.
Creating prompts for FLUX.2 or FLUX.1 models
Text-to-image (T2I) generation
Image-to-image (I2I) editing with FLUX.2 models
Color-accurate brand generations
